recent_articles.title: 4 Migrant Workers From Bengal Caught With 35 Kg Marijuana In Kerala
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** in Kerala seized 35 kilograms of marijuana and arrested four West Bengal migrant workers during an anti-narcotics operation called "Operation Toofan". The arrests were made in Perumbavoor, where the migrants had allegedly transported the drugs from West Bengal by train and autorickshaw. The contraband was concealed in travel bags and is estimated to be worth Rs 10 lakh. Authorities suspect the accused were planning to sell the narcotics through local networks targeting migrant workers.

recent_articles.title: J&K tribal leader who protested at demolition site faces charges of ‘attempt to murder, rioting with deadly weapons’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Talib Hussain Choudhary**, a tribal leader and member of the **Peoples Democratic Party (PDP)**, was arrested on June 1st in Jammu after organizing a protest against the demolition of tribal structures. He faces charges of attempted murder, rioting, and possessing deadly weapons, according to an FIR filed at the Bagh-e-Bahu police station. The police allege that Choudhary led a gathering of approximately 100-150 people who obstructed public movement and pelted stones at police officers while attempting to march towards the National Highway. **Mehbooba Mufti**, former Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, criticized the arrest, stating it was an unfair response to Choudhary's peaceful protest for the rights of his community.

recent_articles.title: ‘Doctoron ne mana…’: Gurmeet Choudhary on wife Debinna’s miscarriages; expert weighs in | Health News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gurmeet Choudhary** and **Debina Bonnerjee**, a television couple, recently shared their long journey to parenthood on the reality show *Tum Ho Naa*. They experienced several miscarriages before welcoming daughters Lianna and Divisha.  Dr. Gaana Sreenivas, an Obstetrician & Gynaecologist, explained that recurrent miscarriages can be caused by various factors including hormonal imbalances, uterine abnormalities, and autoimmune conditions. He emphasized the importance of comprehensive evaluation to identify underlying causes and personalized treatment plans for improved pregnancy outcomes.

recent_articles.title: Bihar government orders Statewide audit of all government aided madrasa and Sanskrit schools - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar's** **Education Department** has ordered a statewide audit of all government-aided Madrasas and Sanskrit schools to ensure compliance, prevent fraud, and guarantee proper use of government funds. A three-member committee will conduct physical inspections across the state, with any unrecognised or fraudulent institutions facing closure. The order was issued by State Education Department Secretary **Vinod Singh Gunjiyal**.

recent_articles.title: Bihar BJP’s Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya mega training campaign-2026 concludes - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bihar BJP** concluded its "Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Mega Training Campaign-2026" on May 31, 2026. The month-long campaign, which involved nearly 20,000 party workers across all 52 organizational districts, focused on training in organizational, ideological, and political subjects.  **Bihar BJP President Sanjay Saraogi**, **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary**, and **State Training Convenor Mrityunjay Kumar Jha** addressed the concluding sessions of the campaign. The training curriculum covered a wide range of topics, including national challenges, government initiatives, organizational structure, and cultural nationalism.  Mr. Jha praised the campaign's success in demonstrating exemplary organizational capability and discipline.

recent_articles.title: 39 Hardinge Road: The Reason Why Rabri Devi Doesn't Want To Vacate Bungalow
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rabri Devi**, former Bihar chief minister, has refused to vacate her 10 Circular Road bungalow in Patna despite an eviction notice from the **Bihar government**. The state government has allocated her a new house on Hardinge Road, but she remains adamant and claims superstition is behind her resistance.  The property has been a symbol of her political career for over two decades and is now being contested by the government.

recent_articles.title: Let Them Evict Me By Force, I Won't Vacate: Rabri Devi On Bihar Residence, RJD, Bungalow Row, Samrat Choudhary
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rabri Devi**, former chief minister of Bihar and leader of the opposition, has refused to vacate her government-allotted bungalow at 10 Circular Road despite an order from the building construction department to move. The order was issued in May to **Nand Kishor Ram**, the Dairy and Fisheries Minister in the NDA government.  **Leshi Singh**, the minister for building construction, stated that the previous order allotting the house to **Rabri Devi** remains valid and she should relocate to 39, Hardinge Road. The situation has sparked controversy with RJD spokesperson **Chittaranjan Gagan** accusing the ruling NDA of targeting opposition leaders.

recent_articles.title: Govt committed to strengthening public infrastructure: Deputy CM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary** conducted surprise inspections of government offices in Jammu, focusing on project progress and efficiency. During his visit to **Bagh-e-Bahu**, he reviewed the construction of a new Dak Bungalow, emphasizing timely completion and quality standards.  He also inspected the offices of the Chief Engineer, PMGSY Jammu and Chief Engineer, M&HED, Jammu, reviewing staff attendance and project status.  **Choudhary** stressed transparency, accountability, and efficient public service delivery in order to ensure timely project execution for the benefit of the people.

recent_articles.title: Govt committed to responsive governance, grassroots development: Deputy CM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary** conducted a tour of Nowshera, inspecting developmental projects and healthcare facilities. He met with delegations and individuals to address public issues and concerns. During his visit to the Sub-District Hospital Nowshera, **Choudhary** assessed patient care and directed authorities to improve healthcare services.  He also reviewed ongoing works at the Dak Bunglow Nowshera, emphasizing the need for timely completion and quality standards.

recent_articles.title: Inclusion of Maithili in CBSE curriculum will connect future generation to their roots: Bihar CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** hailed the decision by the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)** to include Maithili as a subject at the secondary level starting in 2026-27.  The move, supported by **BJP leader Gopal Ji Thakur**, was requested by Mr. Thakur and confirmed by **Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and **Minister of State for Education Jayant Chaudhary**. **Sanjay Saraogi**, Bihar BJP President, also welcomed the decision as a tribute to Maithili's cultural heritage and linguistic pride.  Mr. Saraogi emphasized that the inclusion will promote language learning and cultural understanding among future generations.

recent_articles.title: Plea in Supreme Court to probe Cockroach Janta Party ‘activities’, fake law degrees - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A Supreme Court petition filed by advocate Raja Choudhary challenges the commercial exploitation and monetization of oral court proceedings, particularly sparked by Chief Justice Surya Kant's remarks about "cockroach" law degree holders. The petition names **the Union Government**, **the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology**, **the Bar Council of India**, and **the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** as respondents. Choudhary argues that the online dissemination of isolated court fragments, meme-ified and commercially circulated, disregards constitutional context and represents a distortion of legal proceedings. The petition seeks a probe into fake law degrees across the country by the CBI and highlights historical use of metaphors in literature and jurisprudence to express institutional anxieties.

recent_articles.title: Bihar CM woos investors with amended package, says govt.’s top priority is ensuring safety - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the Chief Minister of Bihar, emphasized the government's commitment to ensuring the security of businessmen and boosting industrial growth in the state. He inaugurated a business conclave organized by the **Bihar Chamber of Commerce and Industries** to mark its centenary year. The CM highlighted the "Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Package-2025" aimed at attracting private investment, while assuring investors that their safety is paramount. Choudhary also addressed concerns about crime and caste politics, stating that criminals are not defined by their background and the government will prioritize investor security.

recent_articles.title: Govt. to soon bring in an AI policy to transform Bihar: CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** announced the state government's intention to introduce an AI policy, aiming to transform Bihar into an AI hub.  He highlighted the potential of AI in India's communication revolution and emphasized the importance of collaboration with younger generations. The summit, organized by the IT Department in collaboration with the **Bihar Industries Association (BIA)** and Qlass EdTech, saw participation from Deputy Chief Minister **Bijendra Prasad Yadav**, Information Technology Minister **Nitish Mishra**, and founder of BharatGPT **Ankush Agrawal**.

recent_articles.title: One more Trinamool councillor from Bidhannagar arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **TMC** councillors from the municipality of Bidhannagar, **West Bengal**, have been arrested in recent days for charges including intimidation, violence, extortion, and money laundering.  The arrests follow a crackdown by the new **BJP** government after the 2021 Assembly election. Several other TMC leaders, including a local union leader and a former minister, have also been arrested on various charges. The arrests come amid allegations of post-poll violence and threats against citizens.

recent_articles.title: Gujarat Police trace 701 missing persons under ‘Operation Milap’ in two weeks - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gujarat Police** have successfully reunited 701 missing persons with their families through a statewide operation called **Operation Milap**, which ran from May 7 to May 21.  The initiative, aimed at reviewing pending missing person cases, involved analyzing old records and conducting fresh field verifications. The drive also included checking digital records, social media activity, transport locations, and shelter homes, with officials noting some cases were linked to trafficking networks. **Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi** stated the government provided resources for the operation.

recent_articles.title: Bihar cabinet approves ₹10.40 cr VGF to operate direct flight between Gaya Ji-Bangkok - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bihar** cabinet approved ₹10.40 crore in Viability Gap Funding (VGF) to support direct flights between Gaya Ji and Bangkok, with **Indigo Airlines** selected to operate the service. The funding will be provided for up to 12 months and will initially cover two weekly flights.  The decision is expected to boost international air connectivity and religious tourism by attracting Buddhist pilgrims from Thailand. Additionally, the cabinet approved ₹747.97 crore from the Bihar Contingency Fund for rural healthcare infrastructure development.

recent_articles.title: Bihar cabinet approves ₹10.40 cr VGF to operate direct flight between Gaya Ji-Bangkok - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bihar** cabinet approved ₹10.40 crore in Viability Gap Funding (VGF) to support direct flights between Gaya Ji and Bangkok, with **Indigo Airlines** selected to operate the service. The decision aims to boost international air connectivity and attract religious tourism from Thailand.  The VGF will be provided for up to 12 months, with the airline initially operating two flights weekly. The cabinet also approved funding for healthcare infrastructure development, an industrial reservoir project, and border security enhancements.

recent_articles.title: One month of Samrat Choudhary Government in Bihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, took office as Chief Minister of Bihar on April 15, 2026.  He has implemented several initiatives focusing on development and combating corruption, including a blueprint for 11 satellite townships across 10 districts. The government also launched the "Police Didi Scheme" to enhance women's safety, established a three-tier public support system, and approved significant funding for education and infrastructure projects. Choudhary has also introduced measures to promote transparency in private schools and prioritize local contractors on civil projects.

recent_articles.title: Setback for NDA as RJD wins MLC byelection in Bihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)** won the Bhojpur-Buxar Legislative Council seat in a byelection, defeating the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** candidate. **Sonu Rai**, representing the RJD, secured victory with 2,486 votes, while his opponent, **Kanhaiya Prasad** of the JD(U), received 2,146 votes. The RJD has attributed their win to alleged manipulation and fraud in the electoral process.

recent_articles.title: Amid Sultan Palace row, tourism minister says such heritage structures will be beautified - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kedar Prasad Gupta**, the new **Tourism Minister of Bihar**, stated that heritage buildings will be beautified in the state.  Following reports suggesting the Sultan Palace might be demolished for a five-star hotel, Mr. Gupta assured citizens that the palace would be preserved and made part of the heritage hotel project. The project was initially approved in 2024 but faced controversy after a report claimed the palace was not listed as a heritage building.  Citizens have demanded the composition of a panel investigating the palace's conservation status be made public, while some suggest listing the palace is crucial for its preservation.

recent_articles.title: Nitish and BJP have no moral right to speak on dynastic politics, says Tejashwi Yadav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tejashwi Yadav**, leader of the opposition in Bihar's Legislative Assembly, criticized **Nitish Kumar** and **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for their involvement in dynasty politics following the expansion of the **Bihar Cabinet**.  Yadav argued that both the **BJP** and its allies are engaging in dynasty politics, citing examples like the inclusion of sons of former Chief Ministers in the new cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Nitish Kumar’s son Nishant among 32 to take oath as Bihar Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nitish Kumar's** son, **Nishant Kumar**, and 30 others were sworn in as ministers in the Bihar government on Thursday.  The ceremony was attended by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**, Home Minister **Amit Shah**, and other senior leaders of the ruling NDA. **Samrat Choudhary**, who took over as Chief Minister after **Nitish Kumar** resigned, expanded his cabinet with former Deputy Chief Minister **Vijay Kumar Sinha**, and former Ministers **Shrawon Kumar** and **Ashok Choudhary**.  The oath-taking ceremony was presided over by Governor Lt. Gen. (Retd) Syed Ata Hasnain.

recent_articles.title: Bihar cabinet approves 500 million U.S. dollars loan from World Bank - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bihar** Cabinet approved a $500 million loan from the **World Bank** to boost economic development and urban infrastructure. The state also plans to train members of its legislative assembly and government officials in Artificial Intelligence (AI) to position Bihar as a leader in this field.  Additionally, the cabinet approved the purchase of 400 electric AC buses under the PM E-Bus Sewa Yojana for various cities across the state, and the transfer of land to the **Airport Authority of India** for airport infrastructure development. The Cabinet also extended the implementation of the Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Package (BIIPP) 2025 until June 30, 2026.

recent_articles.title: Nitish Kumar’s son Nishant Kumar may join Bihar cabinet on May 7 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nitish Kumar's** son, **Nishant Kumar**, is a subject of speculation regarding his potential inclusion in the new **Samrat Choudhary**-led NDA government cabinet.  Senior **JD(U)** leaders met with **Nitish Kumar** and held meetings in Patna ahead of the Cabinet expansion scheduled for Thursday. The event will be attended by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**, Union Home Minister **Narendra Modi**, BJP president **Nitin Nabin**, and other senior NDA leaders, but no official confirmation has been made regarding **Nishant Kumar's** inclusion.  The administration is preparing for the ceremony at Gandhi Maidan with security personnel, police dogs, and waterproof tents to ensure a smooth event despite weather warnings of hailstorms and rain.

recent_articles.title: Vietnam President in India: Vietnam President To Lam accorded ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan, meets PM Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Lam** of Vietnam was accorded a ceremonial reception at the forecourt of **Rashtrapati Bhavan** in New Delhi on Wednesday, marking his first state visit to India.  He met with **President Droupadi Murmu** and **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, following talks with **National Security Adviser Ajit Doval**. The visit coincides with the 10th anniversary of the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two nations. President Lam will also meet with business leaders in Mumbai, aiming to bolster trade and investment ties.

recent_articles.title: Bihar Cabinet expansion on May 7, Modi, Shah and Nabin to attend event - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin** will be present for the expansion of the **Bihar Cabinet** in Patna on Thursday, May 7, 2026.  The event is expected to feature most members from the previous Nitish Kumar-led NDA government retained, with a few new faces added to fill all 36 berths. The **BJP** aims for a "gala event" and preparations are underway at Gandhi Maidan. **Jitan Ram Manjhi**, leader of the HAM (S), has stated he will not demand a Cabinet berth and is content with whatever is offered.  The expansion is expected to include some new faces, potentially more women Ministers, and may see the return of several existing ministers from both the JD(U) and BJP.

recent_articles.title: Nishant launches Sadbhav Yatra from Bihar’s West Champaran - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nishant Kumar**, son of former Bihar Chief Minister **Nitish Kumar**, launched his 'Sadbhav Yatra' from Bagaha, following in his father's footsteps.  The young leader was accompanied by **Umesh Singh Kushwaha**, the **Bihar JD(U) president**, and **Shrawon Kumar**, the **JD-(U) Legislature Party leader**. He addressed supporters along the route, emphasizing harmony and development for Bihar. The journey is seen as a significant step in Nishant Kumar's political career, potentially bolstering the **JD(U)** after the resignation of his father.

recent_articles.title: Nishant launches Sadbhav Yatra from Bihar’s West Champaran - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nishant Kumar**, son of former Bihar Chief Minister **Nitish Kumar**, launched his "Sadbhav Yatra" from Bagaha in West Champaran district on Sunday, May 3, 2026.  The young leader was accompanied by **Umesh Singh Kushwaha**, the **Bihar JD(U)** president and **Shrawon Kumar**, the JD(U) Legislature Party leader. The yatra is seen as a significant step in Nishant Kumar's political career, following his father's long-held tradition of launching all yatras from Champaran.  He addressed supporters along the route, emphasizing the importance of harmony and development for Bihar.

recent_articles.title: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary proposes system where the children of Ministers and the poor study together - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, Bihar Chief Minister, visited Nalanda for the first time since assuming office on Friday. He praised former Chief Minister **Nitish Kumar**'s development work in Nalanda and across the state while highlighting that Bihar is progressing under the leadership of **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Nitish Kumar**.

recent_articles.title: Bihar govt removes Sanjay Gandhi's name from Patna zoo, dairy technology institute - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The BJP-led government in Bihar** renamed the Sanjay Gandhi Biological Park as 'Patna Zoo' and the Sanjay Gandhi Institute of Dairy Technology as 'Bihar State Institute of Dairy Technology'. The cabinet also approved ₹23,165 crore for a power subsidy scheme, ₹104 crore for degree colleges under the 'Saat Nischay-3' program, and land for a Centre of Excellence for autism treatment.  The government allocated funds for four major road projects, increased monthly stipends for SC/ST students in hostels, and approved the development of model schools with modern labs.

recent_articles.title: BJP-led NDA govt. in Bihar likely to see Cabinet expansion on May 6 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the leader of the NDA government in Bihar, is planning a Cabinet expansion on May 6th.  The expansion is expected to include 16 Ministers each for the **Bharatiya Janata Party** and **Janata Dal (United)**, with smaller allies receiving four Ministers. The new Cabinet will likely feature many members from Nitish Kumar's previous administration.

recent_articles.title: BJP-led NDA govt. in Bihar likely to see Cabinet expansion on May 6 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the leader of the NDA government in Bihar, is preparing for a Cabinet expansion on May 6th.  Speculation suggests that **Bharatiya Janata Party** and **Janata Dal (United)** will each appoint 16 Ministers, while smaller allies will receive four. The expansion may include many familiar faces from Nitish Kumar's previous cabinet due to the Constitutional limit of a maximum of 36 ministers in the state.

recent_articles.title: Will take strict action against officials who hold up files for more than a month, says Bihar CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the Chief Minister of **Bihar**, visited his ancestral village, Lakhanpur, on Sunday (April 26, 2026).  During a public meeting in Munger, he addressed concerns about red-tape and promised strict action against officials delaying file processing. He also emphasized his government's goal of providing basic amenities to all residents and ensuring accessible government services for everyone.

recent_articles.title: Samrat Choudhary approves funds for 75 ITI in first Cabinet meeting as Bihar CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** approved several initiatives during his first Cabinet meeting, including the establishment of 75 state-of-the-art Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) under the **PM SETU** scheme. The Cabinet also sanctioned ₹305 crore for an 11-acre research park at IIT Patna and an additional grant of ₹39 crore for phase 2 of the Incubation Centre at IIT Patna.  The State Cabinet also decided to develop 11 new satellite townships in the state, prohibiting land sales and construction until a Master Plan is prepared.

recent_articles.title: ​A plan of change: On Bihar politics and the BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, a former member of the Rashtriya Janata Dal and Janata Dal (United), was sworn in as the 24th Chief Minister of Bihar on April 15, 2026.  This marks the first time a politician from the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** has held the office. The BJP's strategy for growth involved outgrowing regional partners and shifting power dynamics within the state, culminating in Choudhary's appointment after years of maneuvering.  The move signifies a shift in Bihar's political landscape as the BJP seeks to solidify its hold on the OBC-EBC base that was previously held by **Nitish Kumar**.

recent_articles.title: Bihar CM slams opposition over women's quota bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** criticized the opposition parties for their refusal to support an amendment to the women's reservation bill, calling it a "black day" and vowing retaliation. **Sanjay Saraogi**, state party president of the BJP, announced that the party's women's wing would hold a protest on April 20th against the opposition's stance. The amendment, which grants 33% reservation to women in Parliament, was passed by an overwhelming majority in 2023 but faced opposition from non-NDA parties who were wary of its link with delimitation.

recent_articles.title: JD(U) likely to elect new head of legislature party at Patna meet on April 20 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **JD(U)** is expected to elect a new legislature leader on April 20, 2026, following the resignation of **Nitish Kumar**, who was replaced by **Samrat Choudhary**. The meeting will be held in Patna at **Kumar's** new address. Speculation surrounds senior leader **Vijay Kumar Chaudhary**, currently one of two Deputy Chief Ministers, as a possible candidate for the position.  The party post has been vacant since **Kumar's** resignation on April 14th.

recent_articles.title: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary launches self-enumeration phase of Census 2027 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** launched the self-enumeration phase of Census 2027 from the Chief Minister’s Secretariat, urging citizens to participate in the process. The initiative will be conducted digitally from April 17th to May 1st and includes a House Listing Operations (HLO) phase from May 2nd to May 31st. **Mr. Choudhary** emphasized the importance of accurate data for good governance and development plans, while **former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar** also completed his self-enumeration.  The web-based platform allows citizens to enter their family details online at their convenience.

recent_articles.title: Beneath the euphoria, Bihar’s first BJP Chief Minister faces several significant challenges - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Newly sworn-in **Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary**, a former Deputy Chief Minister in the previous Nitish Kumar government, faces significant challenges as he assumes leadership of Bihar.  **Choudhary**, who joined the BJP in 2017 after a career in opposition parties, must navigate complex coalition dynamics and match the political persona of his predecessor while managing high expectations from the people. He also needs to address financial mismanagement, communal harmony concerns, and doubts about his abilities within the BJP and its ideological parent organization, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS).  **Choudhary** will need to establish his administrative capabilities in a state known for groupism among bureaucrats and broaden the BJP's voter base while maintaining alliances with existing parties.

recent_articles.title: Watch: Delimitation controversy & Bihar’s first BJP CM | Above the Fold | 15.04.2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, President of the **AICC** and Leader of Opposition in Rajya Sabha, announced that the **INDIA** bloc has unanimously decided to oppose the Delimitation Bill.  The death toll from the Sakti power plant explosion in Chhattisgarh rose to 16, while **Samrat Choudhary** was sworn in as Bihar's first BJP Chief Minister. Registration for the Amarnath Yatra is now open, starting July 3rd.

recent_articles.title: Samrat Choudhary sworn in as Bihar’s first BJP CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, newly elected leader of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**, was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Bihar on Wednesday.  He was accompanied by two senior JD(U) leaders, **Bijendra Prasad Yadav** and **Vijay Kumar Choudhary**, who are expected to serve as Deputy CMs. The swearing-in ceremony took place at Lok Bhawan with prominent figures from the BJP and former CM Nitish Kumar in attendance.  The new government is expected to expand after the results of upcoming state elections.

recent_articles.title: Two students dead after taking drugs at concertin Mumbai, say police - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Two** college students died and another remains in critical condition after allegedly consuming drugs at a concert in Mumbai.  The **police** arrested five individuals, including two fellow students and three concert organizers, for their alleged role in the incident. The event took place at the Nesco Exhibition Centre, where attendees consumed alcohol and drugs, leading to health complications for several people. The **Vanrai police** registered a case under various sections of the Indian Penal Code and the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, while the bodies were sent for postmortem.

recent_articles.title: Nitish Kumar exits as Bihar Chief Minister, marks end of an era - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nitish Kumar**, the former Chief Minister of Bihar, resigned on April 14, 2026, marking the end of his two-decade tenure.  The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** will now lead the government in Bihar for the first time.  Kumar's resignation follows a period marked by political shifts and criticism over his administration's focus on "obvious developments" while neglecting broader economic growth. He served as Chief Minister for ten terms, navigating complex socio-political terrain and promoting governance initiatives aimed at inclusivity and development. Kumar's legacy is one of both achievements and controversies, with critics questioning the effectiveness of his policies despite his efforts to improve law and order.  He will now take oath as a member of the Rajya Sabha on April 15th.

recent_articles.title: BJP appoints Shivraj Chouhan as central observer for election of Bihar legislative party leader - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The BJP** appointed Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan as the central observer to oversee the election of a new leader for the party's legislative party in Bihar.  Following **Nitish Kumar's** move to the Rajya Sabha, the process of forming a new government is expected to begin after April 13th. **JD(U)** national working president Sanjay Kumar Jha confirmed that the new government will be formed by the NDA legislators upon the recommendation of the BJP.  The date for the Bihar NDA legislature party meeting has yet to be announced.

recent_articles.title: Samrat Choudhary | Bihar’s saffron face - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nitish Kumar**, Bihar's Chief Minister, resigned from his post on April 14th to take up a seat in the **Rajya Sabha**.  His successor, **Samrat Choudhary**, Deputy Chief Minister and former State BJP president, is considered the frontrunner for the position. A new government is expected to be formed on April 15th following Kumar's resignation.

recent_articles.title: 13 killed, 30 injured in multi-vehicle collision in Bihar’s Katihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A collision involving a bus, truck, and pickup van in Bihar's Katihar district on Saturday evening resulted in at least 13 fatalities and 30 injuries. **Chief Minister Nitish Kumar** announced an ex gratia of ₹2 lakh to the families of the deceased and ₹50,000 to each injured person.  The accident occurred on NH-31 in Kodha block, with initial reports suggesting a bus driver lost control of his vehicle. Officials are investigating the cause of the crash and transporting all injured individuals to Purnea's government hospital.

recent_articles.title: 10 killed, 25 injured in multi-vehicle collision in Bihar's Katihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **bus**, a **truck**, and a pickup van collided on NH 31 in Kodha block of Katihar district, Bihar on Saturday evening, resulting in the deaths of ten people and injuries to twenty-five others.  The accident occurred at approximately 6:30 p.m., with the pickup van passengers traveling from Purnea district. The **bus driver** sustained severe injuries and the investigation is ongoing. ## Bihar Chief Minister Wraps Up 'Samriddhi Yatra' with Development Focus

Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar concluded his "Samriddhi Yatra," a three-leg campaign focused on development, in Sheikhpura on Saturday. The final leg of the yatra saw Kumar inaugurate and lay the foundation for 716 projects worth ₹480 crore in Begusarai and Sheikhpura districts.  Kumar emphasized the state's progress in education and healthcare, highlighting improvements made since his tenure began in 2005. He also criticized the opposition RJD, accusing them of mismanagement during their time in power. Kumar pledged to continue development efforts in Bihar, aiming to create employment opportunities for one million youths over the next five years. Deputy Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary praised Kumar's leadership, emphasizing his commitment to both developmental progress and social justice.
